caption: The drawing depicts sixteen human figures, most of whom are dressed in blue or light blue robes with black shoes and black hats. The majority of the figures are distributed diagonally across the composition, facing various directions, with some appearing to hold objects or instruments. The background is a light tan color, resembling aged paper or fabric. Among the figures, two on the left and lower left are reaching or holding leafy branches, while a figure near the bottom appears to carry a box or loaf. Two figures on the far left and lower left are lighter in color compared to the others. The figures are surrounded by thin, scrolling lines suggesting movement or wind, and two floral motifs are visible at the bottom right corner in pale pink and blue with green stems, adding a decorative element. The drawing uses muted shades of blue, tan, black, and soft pink, with all figures depicted in a similar size and style, emphasizing uniformity in dress and posture.
title: Valance from a set of Bed Curtains
